question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Save Our Shrimpers Act (H R 2071)
plain_language: This bill prohibits federal funds from being made available to international financial institutions (e.g., the International Monetary Fund) for financing activities related to foreign shrimp farms. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Haiti Economic Lift Program Extension Act (H R 6504)
bill_title: Haiti Economic Lift Program Extension Act
plain_language: This bill extends through December 31, 2028, the special duty-free rules for various apparel products imported from Haiti. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Remote Access Security Act (H R 2683)
plain_language: This bill broadens the scope of the U.S. export control system to include remote access of items. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.
